meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装好后,面对 CSV/Parquet/JSON 等数据文件,Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars 等内置引擎做查询、聚合、清洗、制图,并把计算放在最合适的位置(内存内、直接查文件或远程),且绝不使用 pandas,Excel 需先转格式。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV/Parquet/JSON 等数据文件,或做分组、连接、聚合、时间序列、分布、清洗、绘图等数据集任务时触发。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV:按省份分组的销售额总和是多少?
say.note: 用 DuckDB 直接查询文件并报告行数。

say.text: 处理这个 parquet 文件,按时间做滚动平均。
画出这两列的散点图,检查异常值。
say.note: 按规范绘图并做视觉检查。

howto.what_en: Claude processes data files (CSV/Parquet/JSON) with DuckDB/Polars engines: querying, aggregating, cleaning, plotting, choosing where to compute (memory, in-place, remote). No pandas; Excel converted first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze CSV/Parquet/JSON data files or handle group-by, joins, aggregations, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting of a dataset.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV: what is total sales per province?
say_en.note: DuckDB queries the file and reports row counts.

say_en.text: Process this parquet file with a rolling time-series mean.
say_en.note: Polars handles it in streaming mode.

say_en.text: Plot a scatter of these two columns and check outliers.
say_en.note: Follows the chart spec and visual QA.
